BiblicalUsage: lᵉmôw means to, for — a small word with a sharp edge. In Job 27:14, "If his children be multiplied"; and in Job 29:21, "Unto me [men] gave ear". In Job 38:40, "[and] abide in the covert to lie in wait?".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a small word like this carries weight in Job — unto me, for the sword, what shall I answer thee — every direction in the book points to God.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
